description: Search the GB rail timetable for specific trains. The query combines terms: an operator and a headcode ('LNER 1S09', 'EMR 1H26'), a time and a station ('12:19 from Corby' — matched within about ten minutes either side), two stations ('Corby to St Pancras', which also finds trains calling at both), or a planning ID / UID ('C12345', or its first few characters). A headcode alone is not unique: the same four characters run in several parts of the country at once, so results for one headcode can be different trains, told apart by origin and destination. Returns planning IDs to pass to get_train.

date.description: Date to search, yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today (UK time).

query.description: Search text, e.g. 'GWR 1A20', '09:45 from Bath Spa', 'York to Leeds'.

name: find_train
title: Find a train
